scope: Native sequence rename with a present or known absent typed selector, a decoded destination and the native optional existence guard.

RenameSequence.role: Rename one checked persistent or temporary native sequence.
RenameSequence.structure: SequenceSelector, decoded unqualified destination, IF EXISTS, exact release.
RenameSequence.conditions: The old selector must resolve under the fixed native profile and stock occupancy. Absent selectors require IF EXISTS. A present sequence needs a different destination. Namespace stays the same.
RenameSequence.meaning: Preserve generator parameters, runtime state, relation identity and defaults referencing the same physical object. A guarded absent selection emits the native relation absence notice. Occupied destinations can fail atomically at evaluation.
RenameSequence.sql: Render ALTER SEQUENCE, the explicit guard, the resolved selector and one separately quoted destination.

finite.bound: 96 total identities per release. Accept 72 analyzed and 72 direct coordinates. The 24 unguarded absent coordinates each have analyzed and direct typed refusal and one native witness.

exploration.structure: Vary exact quoted source and destination, native namespace precedence, existing and absent selectors, valid local database qualification, transactional context and busy destination.

observations: Exact physical relation identity, native type and generator state, command, diagnostics and rollback.
